name: Porsche 911 Turbo (964)
description:
The Porsche 911 Turbo 3.3 (Type 964) represented a watershed moment in 911 evolution when it arrived in 1991. While the 964 generation that debuted in 1989 brought 85 percent new components to the 911 platform, the Turbo variant took another year to perfect—and the wait was worth it. This was the first 911 Turbo to feature all-wheel drive and represented Porsche's most sophisticated production sports car to date.

At the heart of the 964 Turbo lies a 3.3-liter turbocharged flat-six engine producing 320 horsepower in stock form and 450 Nm of torque. However, this particular example has been extensively modified with aggressive tuning that transforms it into a completely different animal. The turbocharger has been upgraded to run at 1.5 bar of boost, extracting a staggering 550 horsepower from the legendary air-cooled flat-six—more than 70% increase over stock. The engine maintains the characteristic turbo lag and explosive power delivery that defined the turbocharged 911 experience, but multiplied to an almost violent degree.

The modifications extend far beyond the engine bay. The already-wide Turbo body has been further widened and fitted with lighter panels to offset the performance upgrades, while the suspension receives competition-grade components to handle the massive power increase. The brake system has been completely overhauled with larger rotors and multi-piston calipers capable of repeatedly hauling down this 1,375 kg missile from triple-digit speeds. At 2.5 kg/hp, the power-to-weight ratio rivals modern supercars.

Performance is brutal: 0-100 km/h arrives in just over 5 seconds, but it's the mid-range acceleration that truly defines the experience—when the turbo spools and 530 Nm of torque hits the rear-biased all-wheel-drive system, the 964 Turbo launches forward with an intensity that few modern cars can match. Top speed exceeds 320 km/h, pushing well beyond the stock car's 270 km/h capability. The chassis, already renowned for its composure thanks to the 964's revised suspension geometry and AWD system, now requires absolute commitment and skill to exploit fully.

This heavily modified 964 Turbo represents the ultimate expression of air-cooled 911 performance—taking Porsche's already formidable turbocharged platform and pushing it to extremes that would have seemed impossible when the car was new. It's a car that demands respect, rewards bravery, and reminds you why the 964 Turbo remains one of the most iconic 911 variants ever built.
